# The bank fee of usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_shares_bought.txt
# edited with `--strategy update` into a sale of 5 of the 10 shares, giving no
# guid.
#
# A sale draws down the shares' cost basis, and an edit runs none of the
# checks a disposal meets, so it is refused and sent to delete-and-import. A
# share's side is its account's type: what a split brings in past zero is read
# for currency alone.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
